content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I want to connect a [product_name] [article_no] module to a Mitsubishi HMI E1101 panel. The outgoing signals from the [product_name] are set up using VM mapping, but I'm unsure how to access this via E-Designer. Can anyone assist?
Hi [user_name], welcome to the forum. Do you have any manuals available? Does E-Designer have a driver for the [company_name] S7 protocol?

I've searched for detailed instructions but couldn't find them. From my experience working on ships, I know that [company_name] modules support Mitsubishi panels, so I believe combining with [product_name] should be possible. E-Designer includes dedicated drivers for [product_name] products, such as S7 ISO over TCP/IP and others.

The [product_name] doesn't support those protocols, including S7 ISO over TCP/IP. The [product_name] [article_no] only works with Ethernet TCP/IP, and from version [version_no] onwards, it additionally supports Modbus TCP/IP.
But isn't [product_name] able to communicate with [product_name] HMI panels using the same protocols as the E1101? Either via TCP/IP or VM mapping. How is this done? [url]
Yes, but only with Ethernet TCP/IP as mentioned earlier. This is different from S7 ISO over TCP/IP.
If you look at the video, the [company_name] panel uses a specific communication driver called [product_name]. This driver is based on the S7 protocol with Ethernet TCP/IP.

Are you sure [product_name] can't use TCP/IP? I've found examples of similar HMI panels connected to [product_name] through this protocol: [url], [url] (The page is in Czech, but you can see the selected communication protocol is [product_name] S7 ISO TCP).
If you think it's the same, give it a try and see.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to connect a [product_name] module with a Mitsubishi HMI panel but is unclear about compatible communication protocols and cannot find straightforward documentation or guidance. There is overall uncertainty about protocol support, leading to confusion when integrating [company_name] hardware with third-party HMIs due to a lack of clear resources.
analysis.user_expectations: User hopes the [product_name] module will communicate reliably with Mitsubishi HMI panels via commonly used protocols such as TCP/IP or through VM mapping, and expects detailed, step-by-step guidance to be readily available.
